description: An orange shopping bag with dark rope handles sits on a yellow tabletop against a white corner wall, with both hands visible near the front edge of the table. The right hand reaches forward toward the bag’s handles, grasps one handle to lift the bag up and slightly toward the center, then lowers and releases it back onto the tabletop while the left hand stays low and mostly still without touching the bag (the bag is a right-hand object during the lift).
